notes.title: "Double Heroes' Legacy" Update announcement on June 26th
notes.notes:
"Double Heroes' Legacy" Update Announcement on June 26th:

New addition: 1. New chapter on the Emperor's line: The Sanskrit Dance Troupe, well-known throughout the world, is making its first move with hidden intentions

2. A new chapter on the emperor's line: The emperor is foolish. He seeks the Dao and immortals only for the Great Xia, not for the elixir of immortality

3. A new female lead in the emperor storyline - Xing Yao

4. New interactive gameplay added
